'''Technoliths''' were massive structures found on the artificial world of [[Iokath]]. Built by [[Unidentified Iokath species|Iokath creators]] and maintained by droids after the [[Iokath Civil War]] left no organic life on the world, the Technoliths served as access points for the massive network of information storage spread across Iokath. They could function as holo-terminals for live communications, relay archived messages and otherwise provide access to the massive amount of data that was several millennia old by the time Iokath was re-discovered in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Technoliths appear on Iokath in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.
